description: [Free] Sets (or with null clears) the account-wide URL that receives a signed JSON event whenever a render ends. The first time a secret is needed it is created and returned here, once.

url.description: Public https URL for the completion event of every render that has no callback_url of its own; null removes it. Signed as callback_url describes on create_video.

name: set_webhook
title: Set the account's completion webhook
